title: Ashwin talking success (and quits)

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Hey boss!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey boss!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ashwin. Any success with these C.E.I.s?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ashwin. Any success with these C.E.I.s?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ashwin. Any success with these C.E.I.s?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ashwin. Any success with these C.E.I.s?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Please tell me there's no more new cleaning technology we need to buy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please tell me there's no more new cleaning technology we need to buy.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Please tell me there's no more new cleaning technology we need to buy.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Please tell me there's no more new cleaning technology we need to buy.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: We're there boss! The new chemicals work. All tests passed. We are 100% microorganism free for at least 24 hours after treatment.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: We're there boss! The new chemicals work. All tests passed. We are 100% microorganism free for at least 24 hours after treatment.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Our new range of cleaning products - paired with aggressive nanobots - are eliminating bacteria more effectively than any of our rivals.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Our new range of cleaning products - paired with aggressive nanobots - are eliminating bacteria more effectively than any of our rivals.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So now you're going to market?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So now you're going to market?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So now you're going to market?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So now you're going to market?

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Sure! And the good news is spreading fast. I already have enough orders to pay back my Curzona debt.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure! And the good news is spreading fast. I already have enough orders to pay back my Curzona debt.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's great news.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's great news.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Yeah! Without you and Safia that never would have happened!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah! Without you and Safia that never would have happened!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Right. Safia. It all began with her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. Safia. It all began with her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Right. Safia. It all began with her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Right. Safia. It all began with her.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Anyway, boss. We need to talk about me paying you back.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Anyway, boss. We need to talk about me paying you back.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Please.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: I have three options. First, I could give you 20K Lims right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I have three options. First, I could give you 20K Lims right now.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Second option: you get 2000 Lims every 7 days for the next 15 weeks. That's more money, but stretched out for a longer time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Second option: you get 2000 Lims every 7 days for the next 15 weeks. That's more money, but stretched out for a longer time.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Or third: you get a lifelong free service with my aerosol for all of your restaurants. That should improve your cleaners performance by 100%.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Or third: you get a lifelong free service with my aerosol for all of your restaurants. That should improve your cleaners performance by 100%.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: And on top of that you get 1000 Lims every seven days for 15 weeks. What do you think?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: And on top of that you get 1000 Lims every seven days for 15 weeks. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll take the 20,000 Lims.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll take the 20,000 Lims.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll take the 2,000 Lims for 15 weeks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll take the 2,000 Lims for 15 weeks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll take the 2,000 Lims for 15 weeks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll take the 2,000 Lims for 15 weeks.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'll take the lifelong free service plus 1000 Lims for 15 weeks.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll take the lifelong free service plus 1000 Lims for 15 weeks.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I'll take the lifelong free service plus 1000 Lims for 15 weeks.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I'll take the lifelong free service plus 1000 Lims for 15 weeks.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: As you wish, boss. The money's in your account!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: As you wish, boss. The money's in your account!

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: I already advised my bank. The first payment should be in your account.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I already advised my bank. The first payment should be in your account.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: I will deliver the aerosol and teach your cleaners how to use it. And the first payment should already be in your bank account.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I will deliver the aerosol and teach your cleaners how to use it. And the first payment should already be in your bank account.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: I'm also sorry to inform you that I have to quit as your cleaner. My new company takes all my attention!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm also sorry to inform you that I have to quit as your cleaner. My new company takes all my attention!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Good luck Ashwin.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good luck Ashwin.

nodes.speaker: Ashwin Chopra
nodes.text: Thank you my friend!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thank you my friend!
